final: WITH color_counts AS (SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) AS color_count FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), totals AS (SELECT SUM(color_count) AS total_count FROM color_counts), first_pairs AS (SELECT c.color_count, CAST(c.color_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS count_fraction FROM color_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(color_count) AS average_count FROM first_pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.color_count, p.count_fraction, p.color_count - a.average_count AS excess FROM first_pairs AS p CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_count IS NOT NULL AND p.color_count > a.average_count) SELECT SUM(color_count), AVG(count_fraction), AVG(excess) FROM kept
